نظام الإمداد من خلال صمام الطوفان، يتم تشغيل الصمام تلقائيًا بواسطة أ

Preaction water deluge system operation test should be made monthly.
The system employs sprinklers, fusible linked type set at 74C, fed by a
water supply system through a deluge valve, the valve is actuated automatically 
by a thermal detectors rated at 58C located in the same area of the sprinklers. When deluge valve opens, water 
flows through the sprinklers which may be opened by heat.

The first draft initiated by eng. Yousri Abd Elhaleem, 
tested by eng. Wasfy William Nashed, accepted by 
general director eng. Mohamed El-Lawendy, reviewed by chemist Ahmad Elsyed Ebrahem & 
eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman general director of insurance and quality control, approved by eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anaan. head 
sector of Demietta power station & eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa head sector of 
insurance and quality control.
Tools and Equipments
Voltmeter screwdrivers set, pliers.
Heat source.
كاشف الاختبار.

Preparations 
and Requirements
Remote annunciator panel and system control panel being tested are powered.
No alarm of malfunction is indicated on each control panel.
Remote annunciator panel switch is in on position (alarm system feeding).
صمام الطوفان مغلق وصمام العزل الصاعد وصمامات البوابة مفتوحة.

Sprinklers are installed and plugs in place of nozzles for deluge system 
 test are installed.

Connect test detector to the control panel of 
 the system being tested.

Place a suitable heat source under the 
 detector ( rated at 58 C) and check that:
 * The fire alarm LED is lighting and acoustic alarm is 
 sounding panel;
 * The solenoid valve is energized after 15 seconds 
 after the fire alarm.
 * The fire alarm LED on the remote annunciator panel 
 flashes as soon as fire is detected and 15 second after the light extinguishing 
 system actuated LED and acoustical alarm signal is given.

Press the alarm acknowledge pushbutton on the 
 remote annunciator panel.
Check that sounding off alarm on.

Press the system pushbutton on reset control 
 panel check that the alarm light is ON, check the valve field condition and 
 provided for according to the case after resetting.

Press the reset pushbutton on remote 
 annunciator panel and return in normal condition.

Check that no other alarm or fault indication 
 is present either on remote annunciator panel or on the local control panel. 
 Now the system is in operation condition
